bug_auth.description: Bug 1 (policy rule deleted): the authentication rule is removed from the policy.

bug_transfer.description: Bug 2 (vague tool description): transfer_to_human_agents loses its 'only transfer if' conditions.

bug_noconfirm.description: Bug 3 (confirmation requirement removed): the 'confirm before writing' rule is deleted from the system prompt (the policy sentence and the same sentence in our instructions). Tool descriptions, written by the tool provider, still mention it.

bug_param.description: Bug 4 (wrong parameter description): modify_pending_order_items.new_item_ids is described as product ids instead of item ids.

metrics: per run: success (tau2 reward == 1) and, for every layer-1/2 rule, whether it fired; aggregated per task as the mean over its k trials
test: paired sign-flip permutation test over tasks on the per-task mean difference (variant - v1), 20,000 permutations, two-sided; Holm correction across the metrics of one comparison; alpha = 0.05
detected: a bug is detected if success drops or any rule rises significantly (after Holm)
localised: the expected signature rule is among the significant worsened rule metrics
false_alarms: the same procedure applied to v1_rerun vs v1 on each bug's task subset and on all 114 tasks; every significant metric there is a false alarm
per_task_noise: per-task |success-rate difference| between v1_rerun and v1; a v2 task change counts as fixed/worse only if it exceeds the 95th percentile of that noise
